fields.label: Redirect URI (register this in Meta App settings)

fields.description: A separate URL from the Redirect URI above — this is for the "Configure webhooks" step in the Instagram product setup, not the OAuth login step.
fields.label: Webhook Callback URL (register this in the Webhooks step)

fields.description: Type any value here, then paste the same value into Meta's "Verify token" field — they just need to match.
fields.label: Webhook Verify Token

fields.options: Create a Meta App with the Instagram Graph API product, add the Redirect URI above under Facebook Login for Business, and request the instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement scopes. The connected account must be an Instagram Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page where you are an admin. Separately, the product's "Configure webhooks" step (not needed for publishing, but Meta may still require it to complete setup) wants the Webhook Callback URL + Verify Token above.

fields.label: Redirect URI (register this in the LinkedIn app)

fields.options: Create a LinkedIn app with the Share on LinkedIn and Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect products, add this Redirect URI under OAuth 2.0 settings, and request the openid, profile, w_member_social scopes.

fields.label: Redirect URI (register this in the X app)

fields.options: Create an X app with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE) enabled, add this Redirect URI, and request the tweet.read, tweet.write, users.read, offline.access scopes. Posting requires at least the Free API tier with write access.
